digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow completion recovery and error reporting
propositions: Step-budget repetition diagnostics are computed in interpret_failure via usage_log.failure_usage but discarded before reaching the gate_error_v1 sidecar or operator message because failure_diagnostic is only set in recovery paths that budget exhaustion never reaches

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist currently filters out repetition keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and rejects list-valued data, preventing the already-computed loop-vs-exhaustion discriminator from surviving the exception merge

Operators have escalated budgets (480→1600, 480→1200) against constraints that were never budget limits, when the measurement distinguishing looping from space exhaustion was available on the first run

The fix widens _bounded_diagnostic to allowlist repetition keys, permits list-typed top_repeated_tool_calls through merge, and renders the aggregate_-prefixed projection through format_repetition in the operator message so distinct-vs-total counts are visible without log reading
Diagnostic filtering on the primary-exception merge prefixes keys with aggregate_, requiring raise_completion_workflow_failure to project the prefix off before rendering through format_repetition
Privacy is preserved: sidecar payload carries hashed signatures and counters only, no prompts, tool arguments, or response text
